## Use Kode Mono in VS Code

Paste this into your settings to set Kode Mono for the editor. The fallbacks are the same ones CodeFont writes.

{
  "editor.fontFamily": "'Kode Mono', 'JetBrains Mono', 'SF Mono', Monaco, 'Cascadia Code', 'Roboto Mono', monospace",
  "editor.fontLigatures": true
}

Copy

Kode Mono is available from Google Fonts.

## About the Kode Mono coding font

A variable coding typeface with programming ligatures. Kode Mono is a free monospace coding font with programming ligatures.

Kode Mono is hosted on Google Fonts, so the specimen above renders without installing anything locally. It is one of the 95 families in the CodeFont catalog.

## Kode Mono FAQ

### Is Kode Mono free?

Yes. Kode Mono is free to use; check the official source for the exact licence terms.

### Does Kode Mono support ligatures?

Yes. Kode Mono ships programming ligatures. Use the ligature switch above the specimen, or set "editor.fontLigatures": true in VS Code.

### Where can I get Kode Mono?

Kode Mono is available from Google Fonts. The download links are listed in the Where to get section above.
